start: Owner signed in, single-branch gym online; Settings

steps.action: Open Settings
user_sees: Title 'Settings', subtitle 'Gym details, opening times and the admin app'
Tabs 'Gym', 'Member app', 'Sign-in & data'
Cards in order: 'Your MettleUp plan', 'Gym details', the install card, the alerts card, 'Payments', the branches card, the entry machines card, 'Gym timings'
must_not: The card 'Your gym is saved in this browser only.' on an online gym
Details of another gym in the boxes

steps.action: In 'Gym details' change 'Gym name', 'Phone', 'GSTIN (optional)', 'Address' and 'Gym UPI ID (optional)', tap 'Save details'
user_sees: 'Saving…'
Toast 'Saved.'
The new name in the top bar and, for members, in the app
must_not: 'Saved.' when the save failed
The GSTIN saved in small letters
The name changed in the panel but not for members

steps.action: Tap 'Open payments', come back, tap 'Open gym timings'
user_sees: The Payments page, then the Gym timings page
must_not: Typed but unsaved details saved by leaving
A dead button on an online gym

start: Owner of a gym with two branches, one branch open

steps.action: Open Settings
user_sees: The card is titled 'This branch’s details' and the first box 'Branch name'
Hints that speak of this branch
must_not: 'Gym details' and 'Gym name' on a branch
The other branch's address or GSTIN

steps.action: Change the address and tap 'Save details'
user_sees: Toast 'Saved.'
must_not: The other branch's details changed
The whole gym renamed

start: Owner on the Gym tab; wrong input and a gym that is not online

steps.action: Clear the gym name and tap 'Save details'
user_sees: A red line under the name box
must_not: 'Saved.'
A gym with no name

steps.action: Type a GSTIN that is not a real GSTIN shape
user_sees: A red line under the GSTIN box
must_not: The wrong GSTIN saved and printed on receipts

steps.action: Type a UPI ID with no @ part
user_sees: A red line under the UPI ID box
must_not: A UPI ID saved that makes a dead pay link

steps.action: Save while the write fails
user_sees: A red line at the top with the reason, or 'Could not save your gym details.'
must_not: The spinner stops with no word

steps.action: Open Settings on a gym kept in the browser only
user_sees: 'Your gym is saved in this browser only. Put it online to keep it safe and open it on any phone or computer.'
Button 'Open Sign-in & data'
No 'Your MettleUp plan' card and no entry machines card
'First put your gym online in Settings → Sign-in & data. Then you can add your timings for members to see.' with 'Open gym timings' greyed
must_not: A timings page that cannot save
The gym said to be safe online

steps.action: Clear the UPI ID and tap 'Save details'
user_sees: Toast 'Saved.'
Fee messages no longer carry a pay link
must_not: The old UPI ID still used in messages

steps.action: Change the name, save, change it back, save
user_sees: The old name everywhere again
must_not: Members still seeing the name in between

steps.action: Open another gym under the same screen (another branch, or the demo gym)
user_sees: Every box starts again from that gym
must_not: Save gives the new gym the old gym's UPI ID or GSTIN

steps.action: Open Settings before and after visiting Payments for the first time
user_sees: A 'new' dot beside 'Open payments', then no dot
must_not: The dot stays for ever

steps.action: Read the hint under each box before saving
user_sees: Each hint says where the value is shown: the name in the member app, the phone and address on the web page while pages are open, the GSTIN on receipts, the UPI ID in fee messages
must_not: A hint naming the web page while web pages are closed
The UPI ID shown to people outside the gym's own messages and pay screens

steps.action: Sign in as a desk person and open Settings
user_sees: None of the gym details
must_not: The desk can read or change the GSTIN, the UPI ID or the MettleUp plan

steps.action: Open Settings
user_sees: Title 'Settings', subtitle 'Screen colours, app and your sign-in'
Card 'Dark or light' with the switch
Card 'Members' with 'Import members from Excel'
The sign-in card, the install card and the alerts card
must_not: Tabs
'Gym details'
'Your MettleUp plan'
'Payments'
The entry machines card

steps.action: Switch between Dark and Light
user_sees: The whole panel changes colour at once
must_not: One part left in the old colours

steps.action: Tap 'Import members from Excel'
user_sees: The import page
must_not: A dead button with internet on

start: Desk person tries to reach the owner's parts

steps.action: Type the address of the Member app tab or the Sign-in & data tab
user_sees: The desk's short Settings, the same as before
must_not: Gym details
The gym's app code
Erase or download buttons

steps.action: Type the address of Pay MettleUp
user_sees: 'Only the gym owner can pay MettleUp'
must_not: MettleUp's bank details

steps.action: Tap 'Import members from Excel' with the internet off
user_sees: The button waits for the internet and says so
must_not: An import that looks done but is not saved

start: Desk person on the short Settings

steps.action: Choose Light, close the panel, open it again
user_sees: Light is kept on this device
must_not: Back to Dark by itself
The owner's device changes colour too

steps.action: Turn alerts on for this device, then off
user_sees: The alerts card shows the new state each time
must_not: Alerts still arriving after off

steps.action: Sign out from the sign-in card
user_sees: The sign-in page
must_not: The gym's records still readable after sign-out
